instruction.name: vsrarn.b.h
instruction.description: Arithmetic right shift with rounding each signed 16-bit element in `a` by the corresponding element of `b` modulo 16, write the lower 8 bits of the shifted result into the lower half of each 128-bit lane of `dst`, and zero the upper half.

experiments.name: dependent vector chain
experiments.notes: Consecutive unrolled copies form a vector-register dependency chain. Measured with unroll=100000 to amortise call overhead.

latencies.notes: Register-to-register latency. Raw measurement was 4.04; the residual is a systematic +0.03..0.1 calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.
